name: Webform Submit Timer
description: Adds a submit-delay timer to Webforms (block submission until a minimum time has elapsed).
project_description:
The Webform Submit Timer module allows site administrators to add a submit delay timer to any Webform.

This feature disables the submit button for a configured number of seconds, giving users time to review their submission or preventing accidental double submissions.

 Features 
 
 Set a custom timer delay (in seconds) for configured Webform. 
 Disable the submit button until the countdown expires. 
 Displays a countdown message with the remaining seconds. 
 Works with all Webforms created in Drupal. 
 Lightweight, dependency only on the Webform module.
